close_reason: 41 compiler/rendering tests cover bare booleans, nil/false dynamics, and spreads on both HTML paths.
description:
Reproduction: ~F"<input disabled={nil}>" renders <input disabled>, disabling the input. TagEngine/VNodeEngine encode both bare disabled and dynamic nil identically.
Instructions: encode bare HTML boolean attributes as true (or another distinct marker); omit evaluated nil and false attributes in both Web.to_rendered and Web.to_iodata. Keep component prop nil semantics unchanged.
Acceptance: compiler-to-renderer tests cover disabled (present), disabled={true} (present), disabled={false} and disabled={nil} (absent), plus nil id/class and spread attributes. Both HTML conversion paths must agree.

comments.text: Validation count correction: the focused compiler/rendering run contained 43 passing tests. Final integrated validation passes 489 tests.

title: Distinguish bare boolean attributes from dynamic nil attributes
